title: Nanak Has Meditated On The Naam
summary: The shabad does not leave forgiveness at diagnosis. It turns toward return.
takeaway: Nanak has meditated on the Naam, the Name of the Lord
lifeApplication: Release one rehearsed sentence you keep feeding with resentment. After the reaction, make the next return smaller and truer.

source.shortMeaning: Sing the Word of the Guru's Bani, O Siblings of Destiny; nanak has meditated on the Naam, the Name of the Lord
source.lifeApplication: Release one rehearsed sentence you keep feeding with resentment. Let this line guide the first honest return after the reaction.

evidence.coreClaim: Sing the Word of the Guru's Bani, O Siblings of Destiny; nanak has meditated on the Naam, the Name of the Lord
evidence.turn: Forgiveness is not the end of the path; it is what makes peace inhabitable.
evidence.practicalImplication: Release one rehearsed sentence you keep feeding with resentment. After the reaction, make the next return smaller and truer.
